propositions: A parent removed in Jira is never cleared in the local rebar ticket because the snapshot omits the parent field when absent and the differ refuses parent_id=None.
The differ's managed_refs gate cannot distinguish 'peer once had this parent' from 'peer never had it', causing unconditional clears to destroy locally-set parents rebar never pushed.
A clear must fire only on positive evidence the peer once carried the parent, tracked via binding_store.get_peer_parent / set_peer_parent advanced by reconcile._advance_peer_parent.
Fail-open reads (degraded parent_map, truncated page walks) must never overwrite good peer observations with 'no parent', or the next pass re-interprets the absence as a deletion.
The three-state parent classification (unobserved / no-parent / resolved / unresolvable) must be observable in snapshots and propagated end-to-end through mutation application.
